original_test_intent: Validate an engineering-defined C2C coherent-link error between the intended NVIDIA components, including detection, containment, persistent reporting, coherent-data behavior and recovery without substituting a different NVLink or register fault.
original_method: Block execution now. Future method identifies the C2C endpoints, link/lane/direction and error class, baselines authoritative link/coherency counters and peer memory state, injects one vendor-defined error, correlates raw component-specific evidence, and proves peer/link availability plus coherent memory/data recovery.
manual_activity: The NVIDIA/platform owner defines the C2C error taxonomy and endpoint pair, approves the single synthetic stimulus and containment, and validates peer/coherent-memory recovery.
required_inputs: Authoritative definition of the C2C Error class and covered protocol layer
Pinned NVIDIA C2C/NVLink RAS tool/spec/version/checksum and supported silicon/firmware/driver/OS
Exact source/destination endpoint, link/lane/direction/instance and topology map
Stimulus command plus severity, containment/reset and raw status/counter/log signature
Coherent memory/traffic ordering, poison/data-integrity, peer availability and deadline criteria
Independent OOB/console/fabric recovery, aborts, clear policy and restoration
safety_requirements: No injection until error class, endpoint scope and containment are approved
Dedicated non-production topology with disposable coherent workload, data hashes and independent OOB/console
Baseline authoritative C2C topology, counters, firmware logs, peer state and coherent data
One mapped event once; abort on poison propagation, data mismatch, peer loss, link/fabric stall, unexpected reset or absent evidence
Preserve first-failure status and restore tool, debug, link and peer state before verdict
agent_execution_scope: Collect only supplied authoritative read-only C2C topology, counters/logs, peer state and coherent workload health
Validate future error-class and target-specific evidence contract
Do not infer C2C from InfiniBand enumeration, choose endpoints, inject, clear, retrain/reset links or peers, recover, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Define the exact C2C error and affected protocol layer
Approve endpoint/link/direction, stimulus, severity and containment
Supervise one event with coherent data monitoring
Recover peers/fabric, restore state and issue verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Inject one explicitly typed C2C error on one mapped endpoint pair and prove target-specific reporting, intended containment and coherent peer/data recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: The source has no method; required error taxonomy, topology, coherent-data and restoration evidence are added without inventing values.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Device enumeration, SCC Creg evidence or generic NVLink counters do not demonstrate the unspecified C2C error.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A coherent-link fault can propagate beyond one endpoint and invalidate shared data before software detects loss of coherency.

project_override_considerations: The project must identify the authoritative NVIDIA C2C management/RAS interface. Linux network/RDMA class membership is not accepted unless the platform specification explicitly maps it to the tested C2C path.
expected_evidence: Approved C2C error taxonomy and source/destination endpoint/link/lane/direction map
Pinned tool/spec and baseline raw C2C counters/status, peer state and coherent data hashes
Exact one-shot typed stimulus with synchronized endpoint/fabric timeline
Fresh target-specific raw status plus firmware/OS/BMC persistent evidence and approved containment
Restored link/peers, coherent traffic, memory ordering, poison state and data integrity
Configuration restoration record and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Define Reliability row113 Wistron-System RAS-00833-V002 C2C Error: state the exact C2C error class/protocol layer and provide the authoritative NVIDIA architecture/tool/spec/version/checksum; map source/destination endpoint, link/lane/direction/instance; specify safe stimulus/command, severity/containment/reset, raw status/counter/persistent evidence, coherent memory/order/poison/data-integrity and peer-availability criteria, OOB recovery, aborts, clear policy and restoration; require fresh review and do not use InfiniBand enumeration as proof unless formally mapped.

review_improvement: Exposes that the title does not name an error class and requires authoritative C2C topology plus coherent-data recovery instead of generic fabric inventory.
independent_technical_reasoning: C2C describes a connectivity domain, not a unique error. Without identifying protocol layer and endpoint pair, any stimulus could test a different mechanism and still emit generic fabric logs. Because coherency failures may silently affect shared state, success must include data and ordering integrity, not only link presence.
